Pre-IPO perpetual futures activity already signals exceptional retail interest. Anthropic-linked contracts changed hands in a record $270 million volume yesterday, underscoring intense demand ahead of the formal debut the firm noted.

Historical patterns tracked by Vanda reinforce the outlook. On major listing days this year, retail turnover measured by VandaTrack has typically reached roughly five times the peak volume observed in pre-IPO perpetual trading. Applying that relationship to the latest Anthropic figures produces an estimate of approximately $250 million in net retail buying on the first day of trading.
Such a figure would more than double SpaceX’s IPO-day retail record of $118 million and rank among the strongest single-session retail inflows ever recorded in an individual stock.
The broader retail environment remains supportive as well, the institution said. NVIDIA
alone attracted $617 million in net retail purchases yesterday—its second-largest daily total on record—highlighting the continued appetite for high-profile technology names.
Taken together, the data points to an outsized retail participation event that could redefine IPO benchmarks.

title: Anthropic's IPO is poised for a historic retail debut, analysis suggests
